[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided information about Puerto Rican salsa, including its characteristics and notable artists.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Characteristics of Puerto Rican salsa include:  
- More rhythmic and percussion-heavy.  
- Emphasis on congas, timbales, and bongos.  
- Complex polyrhythms and syncopation.  
- Fast-paced energy with tempos ranging from 160 to 180 BPM.
